caption: The most even (green) and the most clumped (red) photo of every plant. The zones are coloured by their leaf layers (purple 0, yellow 2.3); the number is the clumping score. The most even photo is usually the wide side of the plant, where the shoots are spread out; the most clumped one is the narrow side, where they line up behind each other into a dense core.
